newsitem.title: JAPAN: Recent currency moves rather large--MOF's Ogawa.
newsitem.headline: Recent currency moves rather large--MOF's Ogawa.

text.p: Currency market movements from last week into this week have been rather large, Japan's Vice Finance Minister Tadashi Ogawa told a news conference on Thursday.
"Stable foreign exchange movements are very important for the economy," he said.

Asked about Japan's current account surplus, Ogawa said that, although the numbers may fluctuate from time to time, "I don't think the situation is such that the surplus will rise drastically in the intermediate term," adding that he was referring to the surplus in trade of goods and services.
